explanation: It stays near 10 at every step while the agent keeps choosing a2, and sits around 8-9 (dropping to 5-7 after trial ~85) while it keeps choosing a1, with GO and D2 always about the same as or slightly above D1. The big dips happen only at D1, falling to 0-4, when the last trial outcome points away from a1 (a1 went to S1 common and got no reward, or a1 went to S2 rare and got a reward), or after two or three unrewarded a2 trials in a row; it then climbs back to 6-9 at GO.
